## Natural history notes

A large grasshopper characterized by its long body, strong jumping legs, and brown to grayish-green coloration that helps it blend into grasses, shrubs, and dry vegetation. In Florida, it is found in open sunny habitats such as prairies, pine flatwoods, fields, roadsides, coastal scrub, and disturbed areas with grasses and low plants. It feeds on leaves and other plant material, often resting on vegetation or bare ground and making strong jumps or short flights when disturbed.
